name: jscalendar-conversion
description: Hand-written cases for the iCalendar <-> JSCalendar recurrence conversion (draft-ietf-calext-jscalendar-icalendar-31 sections 2.3.18, 2.3.30, 2.3.33 and 3.2). `fn` is the function, `input` its first argument, `options` the rest; `expected` is the result, or {"error": true}. Time zones are fixed UTC offsets per case (`offsets`): `eventTimeZone` is the event's JSCalendar timeZone, toEventTime/toUtc are derived from the offsets. `offsets` values may also be lists of [from wall clock, offset] changes (for a time change), and `toInstant` derives that converter from them. `occurrences` lists the recurrence ids the rule generates (isOccurrence). Ids starting with `draft-` are the draft's own figures. `strict` runs the strict mode; otherwise the default (lenient) mode runs, and `warnings`, when given, is the number of warnings expected (none otherwise).

cases.note: Feb 29, 2024 is a Thursday, so the start is not an occurrence; the check expands the rule only up to the start (the next Monday, Feb 29 is in 2072).
2024-10-03 is 1 Tishri 5785; the Gregorian month and day would be wrong.
